extraction.provider_name: Church of the Immaculate Conception of Hendersonville
extraction.notes: The supplied theimmaculate.org pages belong to a different church in Towson, Maryland, not Hendersonville. The Hendersonville parish's official website is ichvl.com. No 2027 summer program information was found. Several parish bulletin files returned empty or incomplete readable text; official search results supplied some 2026 facts. Camp Joshua was advertised for July 17–18, 2026 in parish bulletins, but its organizer now advertises November 13–14 in Hendersonville; a reviewer should determine whether the summer offering was rescheduled.

cards.name: Totus Tuus Summer Faith Formation Week
cards.description: A summer Catholic faith formation program for children and teens with catechesis, witness and worship.
cards.review_notes: Official bulletin search excerpts state rising grades 1–12, $50 per child for the week, and June 7–12, 2026. The May 31 bulletin says there are two separate age-based programs, but their grade divisions, dates, hours and drop-off venues could not be recovered from the readable text. Check the original bulletin before splitting day and evening offerings; the current card conservatively groups them as VBS.

cards.name: Camp Joshua
cards.description: High school students participate in talks, interactive activities and debates about pro-life advocacy.
cards.review_notes: Parish bulletin search excerpts advertise July 17–18, 2026 for rising grades 9–12 at Immaculata Catholic School. NC Right to Life's current website instead advertises Camp Joshua November 13–14 in Hendersonville. Check whether the July camp was rescheduled, in which case it should be excluded as outside summer. Day format is provisional: the readable parish text calls it a two-day camp but does not establish whether overnight lodging was included.
